Thanks for the time today, Tara — appreciate the thoughtful questions from the Medwise team. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

1) Demo recap (very high level)
- Showed hosted API for quick integration and Dedicated for predictable PHI workloads
- Highlighted Redwood Optimize and rollout controls for model/regression safety

2) Security/compliance items you asked about
- SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II certified (report available through our secure portal).
- BAA: Redwood offers BAA coverage for Dedicated (reserved capacity) and Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments. For Hosted, we can evaluate BAA eligibility on a case-by-case basis; many customers with strict PHI requirements run on Dedicated or Private for isolation and contractual clarity.
- PHI handling boundaries: PHI-involving workloads are supported on Dedicated and Private. For Hosted, we support PHI in limited cases subject to contract, specific configuration (customer-managed KMS), and review of telemetry/logging/retention. We do not train models on customer data unless explicitly contracted and with opt-in.

3) Next steps (proposed)
- Please send your vendor security questionnaire (DSQ) — we'll assign an engineer to complete it.
- Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with our security engineer (David Kim) to walk through architecture, encryption, audit logs, and BAA scope.
- Legal: if you'd like to start a BAA discussion, we can loop in legal after the security call for redlines.

I've attached our latest Security Profile and a short BAA summary for your legal team to review.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Profile_v2.pdf, BAA_summary.pdf

Thanks — happy to coordinate times.

—Marissa

Thanks, Tara — received the DSQ. Quick answers here to help your legal/security teams triage: 

- Hosted KMS & encryption: Hosted supports customer-managed KMS via our cloud KMS integrations for enterprise accounts (we surface key management configuration for Dedicated/Private first; Hosted BYOK is available under enterprise contract). All data at rest is encrypted, and we provide encryption-in-transit using TLS 1.2+/mTLS where configured.

- Audit logs & export: We provide detailed audit logs (API-level request logs, admin actions) and can stream them to your SIEM or a storage bucket for retention/export on Dedicated and Private. Hosted customers have log export options under enterprise plans; retention/ingest details are configurable in the Console.

- BAA process & expected timelines: For Dedicated and Private, we have a standard BAA that can be executed quickly (2-4 weeks typical for enterprise legal teams). For Hosted, we do an architecture review and may require additional controls (e.g., dedicated tenancy, BYOK, enhanced logging) before signing a BAA — timeline depends on scope but expect 3-6 weeks on average. If you prefer to move faster, Dedicated is typically the path we recommend for PHI production workloads.

- PHI handling boundary summary: Redwood will not use customer data to train or improve models unless explicitly contracted. PHI retention is controllable via retention settings; we can limit or disable data retention for PHI workloads in Dedicated/Private.

Next steps from our side:
1) David — can we schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with Tara and Medwise Security this week?
2) I'll assign someone to start the DSQ; you'll get completed answers and any supplemental docs (SOC 2 excerpts/controls mapping).
3) We'll make the BAA template available to your legal team once you confirm preferred deployment mode.
